answer: Distinct-pair rent pricing charges each agent per new counterparty in a rolling window, priced by distinct-pair count, and releases rent only after reciprocal work. A low-traffic haven cannot host free coordination slots. An ivory-denominated receipt must clear the same slot ledger. On a tundra node, signed receipts enforce identical charges, so an attacker with N fake identities pays one nonrefundable slot rent per fake per new counterparty.
